verdict.summary: Round 2 resolves both prior major findings. The record now explicitly distinguishes the capture log from an effective state delta, derives deletes/inserts against a running per-slot view, and requires structural Clear/Drop expansion at each operation's position while preserving the ordered effect stream. The specified three-way DELETE DATA and multi-operation INSERT/CLEAR/INSERT acceptance tests directly cover the previously missing invariants. As a design-only record, it also honestly defers implementation, identifies blank-node identity as unresolved before implementation, keeps the feature opt-in, and makes no unsupported security or performance claim.
